Loaded in uSmartLauncher (F9 tap) and HJQBIND (F9 hold)
F9 will not switch modes, and system shortcuts will not pass through in remote mode

How to fix:
1. Pull down the notification shade, open LSPosed and enable the Remote Switch module
2. In its scope, tick uSmartLauncher and HJQBIND
3. Run remoteswitch\deploy.ps1 on the computer, or restart the tablet
All four cells go back to: in tablet mode tap / hold shows the floating UI; in remote mode tap returns to tablet, hold shows the floating UI. The boot setting is kept.
What F9 does. While the floating UI is up, F9 always closes it.
On the tablet F9 opens the floating UI to pick a target; in a remote session a tap goes back to the tablet app you came from, holding opens the floating UI to switch sessions
Straight back to the last session
On the tablet a tap goes straight back to the last remote session, holding opens the floating UI; in a remote session the same as the default

Tags follow the profile name by default (change it under Profile names & colors); tap a row to give one target its own note. The switch controls whether it appears in the floating UI; Alt+↑/↓ or the arrow buttons reorder.

Each user profile has one name and one color. In the floating UI and the target list every client carries this profile tag (dot + name), which tells instances of the same app in different profiles apart. Leave a name empty to restore the default; a target\'s own note wins.
